overview_description.description:
Collective Health is the leading independent third party administrator (TPA) that brings together plan administration, cost management, and taking great care of your people—all in one place. Conventional wisdom in health benefits says you must choose: better or safe. Collective Health allows you to have both.

For self-funded employers, Collective Health provides a unified foundation with Collective TPA™, My Collective®, Care Navigation, Collective Compass®, and Partner Collective®—combining technology, clinical expertise, and a flexible partner ecosystem to simplify administration, improve decision-making, and guide members through their healthcare journeys.

Founded in 2013, Collective Health serves more than 800,000 members from organizations including Red Bull, The Wonderful Company, Boot Barn, Live Nation, Driscoll’s, Uber, and Zoom. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with additional locations in Plano, Texas, and Lehi, Utah.

product.name: Collective TPA™
product.description: A third-party administrator platform for self-funded employers that combines health plan administration, cost management, partner selection, data analysis, and operational support.

product.name: Navigation & Advocacy
product.description: A member-facing benefits navigation and advocacy service that helps employees understand coverage, find care, manage complex healthcare needs, and receive support from care advocates.

product.name: Benefits Hub
product.description: A centralized benefits platform that brings medical and ancillary benefits, partner programs, and benefits information into one employer and employee experience.

product.name: Collective AI (CAI™)
product.description: An artificial intelligence capability embedded in the Collective Health platform that supports member navigation, Member Advocates, annual enrollment, plan implementation, and operational workflows.

product.name: Collective Compass®
product.description: An employer reporting and analytics service that helps benefits teams evaluate healthcare strategy, understand plan performance, and identify opportunities for action.
